geometry.mark: Two original pearl-glass leaves forming a narrow open aperture
geometry.markClearSpace: At least 8% of icon width on each side
geometry.markBackground: Transparent; no enclosing tile unless required by the host

banner.displayType: Generated editorial serif title and smaller italic caption emphasis, rasterized in the artwork
banner.supportingType: Generated sans-serif lettering, rasterized in the artwork
banner.composition: Ink-navy title field at left; nearly flat original two-leaf silhouette at right; an ivory caption plate crosses the seam toward the mark
banner.caption: Tagline breaks after the comma; italic in view. is subordinate to the masthead; metadata sits below one fine divider; all copy shares one left axis
banner.light: Subtle smooth tonal shading inside the leaves; no glass-card layers, reflective floor or caustic light
banner.frame: Fine inset rule spans both fields; the caption plate is attached to the left frame edge

diagrams.flow: Named directed lines; opposite flows may share one bidirectional route
diagrams.ownership: Named region with a visible boundary
